top_signals.title: Gold Declines After Fed’s Warsh Comments on Inflation Trend
top_signals.summary: Gold slipped as Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh warned inflation isn’t slowing significantly and unless policymakers become confident that it is, the central bank has “work to do.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Warsh Says Inflation Isn’t Slowing, Vows to Hit 2% Target
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh warned inflation isn’t meaningfully slowing and said policymakers must be confident that it is, otherwise the central bank has “work to do.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Job Growth Marked Down in Preliminary Benchmark Estimate
top_signals.summary: US job growth was more moderate in the year through March than previously reported, underscoring a downshift in the labor market that prompted the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates in 2025 despite persistent inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
